Drop your .docx (and optional .html) files here, then double-click
apply-rules.bat in the parent folder.

The script will:
  1. Open each file through Word COM (which silently strips most DRM /
     IRM-by-policy as part of the Save round-trip).
  2. Apply MXWhitePaper input rules — see ../README.md.
  3. Run mxwp-validator-win32.exe on each result.
  4. Write format_report.csv next to your files.

You can delete this placeholder file once you've put real files here.
